nom: Good Molecules Maximum Strength Acne Gel Cream

avis.texte: This did not leave my skin flaky or dry at all. It god rid of a very stubborn infectected pimple in only 2 days. The pimple lasted for 1 month before I used this product. Theres a slight tingle after applying but nothing bad at all :)
genuinely cleared up my forehead acne i get when i sweat a lot bc of my bangs. i put it on other blemishes too & it cleared them up! such an incredible and affordable product, highly recommend.

I have never dealt with acne just a few bumps/blemeshes here and there. But about 4 months my chin was constantly breaking out. I couldn't clear it up. I found this cream, started using it and it instantly started working. I put it on twice a say - under makeup and during my nighttime routine.
My skin isn't sensitive, but after about 3 weeks os using this product it caused the worst irritstion and itchy skin of my life. I started out using this oroduct slow too.

I always liked the good molecules line but this one dissapointed me😭found out there was 5 fungal acne triggers to this product and I believe made my acne worse instead. I have combo, sensitve, acne prone skin.

This product is not flashy or boastful. It doesn't smell perfumy. Come to think of it, it doesn't really smell like much of anything I can think of to be honest. What this product is for me is highly effective with daily use after using an acne cleanser to combat and control adult acne. The price is fantastic too. I used to use acne control products from another big company that typically does not use benzoyl peroxide because I'm allergic and their products were not cheap, but over time they kept changing formulas to the point their stuff didn't work for me anymore, so I had to find new stuff. After trying several brands I have found this particular acne treatment gel works best for me so I thought I would share my thoughts here. I am an adult male that has struggled with acne since becoming a teenager with oily/combination skin type

I've tried other versions of retinol and acne products to no avail, and this blew my mind! Left my skin feeling supple, soft, and hydrated surprisingly. No irritation! Be aware there is a "purge" with this initially, but the results are amazing!! I use this in conjunction with their 10% Azelaic Acid to reduce hyperpigmentation as well, and have been very happy with the immediate and long term results from both. If you have sensitive and acne prone skin, this product is the one!
Used neutrogena for years (benzoil peroxide) but this works much better (salicylic acid)

avis.titre: Love it, new bombshell in the acne arsenal
avis.texte: I love this gel-cream texture. It does feel more hydrating than other salycilic based treatments as it wears. I like that it has other gentle exfoliator ingredients too to bust the acne and refresh the skin. The tube has a great amount of product in it for the price point too, another good item from Good Molecules!

My routine used to be focused around benzyl peroxide based products but due to excessive dryness i had stopped and for years had no issues. then, as acne and texture does, i had started noticing a lot more frequent breakouts but refused to get back on benzyl. I saw this product and in a desperate attempt, tried salicylic acid again for the first time since high school and less than a week later my skin in back to being almost perfectly clear and texture-less. Though i hope this review helps, please remember everyone's skin in different and what works for some may not be what works for you, and that's okay :)

I very rarely leave online reviews. I generally like Good Molecules but dont always love the formulation of some of their products. But i was looking for an affodable retinoid and chose this one because of the BHA. Granted, my skin has texture and acne but its not super super acne-prone. I use this not as a spot treatment, but as a retinoid all over my face 3x a week like I did with adaplene. The adaponid in this formula is gentler, yet wirh the BHA I see similar results. Combined wirh the Good Molecules Niacinamide + Ectoin Serum and my regular noisturizer and SPF, I have redisbed many compliments recently. I am sure it is also a good spot treatment, but I hope good molecules leans more into the retinoid component of this product. Heck, it isnt even listed in the retinoids section of their website. Highly highly reccomend.

It works, light gel-cream with sticky finish (moisturizing, heals acne). However, it has weird smell, most likely it stinks (skin, fingertip too). I am sensitive to smells so maybe thats why. After 10 min I don't smell anything, so it's fine
This acne gel is incredible! I've been battling painful acne for the past week, and surprisingly, this product alone has cleared it up, even after using gentle acne cleansers. 🥲< 3

Purchased this to replace another brand's salicylic acid spot treatment that wasn't working for me at all. Within hours of applying this to my blemishes, my skin started to calm and they became noticeably smaller. I'm really starting to love Good Molecules. All the products I've purchased from them have been great, and for a great price, too!
